message.content:
Yes—if you’re experiencing excessive or disruptive noise in Atlanta, you can file a complaint with the city’s authorities. Here’s how you can do it: | Step | What to Do | Where to Go / Who to Contact | |------|------------|------------------------------| | **1. Identify the source** | Determine whether the noise is coming from a residential, commercial, or public property. | — | | **2. Check the noise ordinance** | Atlanta’s Noise Ordinance (Title 10, Chapter 5 of the Atlanta Municipal Code) sets limits on permissible sound levels and defines “quiet hours” (typically 10 p.m.–7 a.m.). | City of Atlanta website – [Noise Ordinance](https://www.atlantaga.gov/). | | **3. Gather evidence** | Take note of the time, duration, and type of noise. If possible, record audio or video (but be mindful of privacy laws). | — | | **4. File a complaint** | • **Online**: Use the City of Atlanta’s 311 portal or the “Report a Problem” section on the official website.
• **Phone**: Call 311 (or 404‑727‑3111 if you’re outside the city).
• **In person**: Visit the City Hall or the local police precinct. | City of Atlanta 311 portal – [Atlanta 311](https://www.atlantaga.gov/311). | | **5. Follow up** | After filing, you’ll receive a reference number. You can track the status via the 311 portal or by calling 311 again. | — | ### Quick Tips - **Quiet Hours**: Most residential areas enforce quiet hours from 10 p.m. to 7 a.m. If the noise occurs during these times, it’s more likely to be actionable. - **Commercial Zones**: Businesses may have different permissible noise levels; check the zoning map for your area. - **Repeat Offenders**: If the same source repeatedly violates the ordinance, the city may issue a citation or fine. ### Contact Information | Agency | Phone | Email | Address | |--------|-------|-------|---------| | City of Atlanta Police Department | 404‑727‑3111 (within city) | [police@atlantaga.gov](mailto:police@atlantaga.gov) | 1000 Peachtree Street NW, Atlanta, GA 30303 | | City of Atlanta 311 | 404‑727‑3111 | — | — | | City of Atlanta Office of the City Clerk (for official complaints) | 404‑727‑3111 | [clerk@atlantaga.gov](mailto:clerk@atlantaga.gov) | 1000 Peachtree Street NW, Atlanta, GA 30303 | If you’re unsure whether the noise violates the ordinance, you can also call the Atlanta Police Department’s non-emergency line for guidance before filing a formal complaint.
